text:
I rewrote the proposal and logged it as "rewrote" in `flags.jsonl`. Nobody currently owns this brief, so I edited it directly. I didn't open any page or screenshot.

`text-check.mjs` flagged nothing. I made two changes to `test-health/requirements.md`:
- **Title:** it now reads "Test health: are the tests real, and do they run?". The "you are a mastermind, on Sonnet" note moved to its own line under the title.
- **Steps:** the five "Do" steps are now `- [ ]` checkboxes, headed "tick each when done", so progress shows as ticks.

I left one thing alone: "3b1fae8d3" in "Known so far" is a bare commit hash that isn't linked.
